result:
Done. Summary:

**Built** `NegotiationTrackerPage` and its owned components (`RoutingPanel`, `ReviewerList`, `OverdueFlagBadge`, `SendReminderButton`, `CompareVersionsModal`, `CommentBoxPanel`, `MarkAgreedButton`) plus 8 hooks, extended `lifecycleNegotiationService.js`/`negotiationSlice.js` (rather than duplicating the sibling task's module), and reused the already-built `OtpVerificationForm` unchanged.

**Verified:**
- Lint, build, and full test suite all pass (41/41 tests, including 6 new ones)
- Visually checked against designs via Playwright with mocked API responses at 1440×900 — Routing Panel (IMG-3/4), Tracker (IMG-5), and Compare Versions (IMG-6/7) all match closely

**Status: PARTIAL**, with 7 blockers recorded — most notably that BR-1/BR-2's pre-submission auto-add banners need contract value/risk data no endpoint in this task's contract exposes to `RoutingPanel`, so I didn't invent a URL and left those two banners unimplemented (mandatory-reviewer badges still work post-submission via `isMandatory`). Full details are in `.ui-gen/outputs/T-NEGOTIATION-TRACKER-PAGE-UI.json`.
